name: Mercado do Bolhão
description: No weekend in Porto is complete without visiting the iconic Mercado do Bolhão. Explore two floors of fresh produce, local cheeses, and delicious prepared foods.
longDescription:
The Mercado do Bolhão is a historic municipal market in Porto, operating since 1914. It serves as a central hub for local vendors to sell a variety of goods, primarily focusing on fresh food products. The market functions as a daily trading space, reflecting traditional Portuguese commerce and supporting local producers.

Visitors to the market on May 23, 2026, can expect to navigate two levels filled with stalls. The atmosphere is generally active, with vendors interacting directly with shoppers. The market primarily features Portuguese spoken by vendors, though many are accustomed to international visitors. It attracts a broad audience, from local residents doing their weekly shopping to tourists exploring Porto's culinary scene. The venue itself is a notable historic building, recently renovated to preserve its original character while modernizing facilities.

Entry to the Mercado do Bolhão is free of charge, and walk-ins are welcome throughout opening hours. The market is centrally located and easily accessible. It is a 5-minute walk from Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) and also within walking distance of Trindade metro station. The market is family-friendly, offering an engaging environment for all ages.
